jobs.description:
For a company based in Veurne, specialised in metalworking, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in various shift systems.

You will be working in an ultra-modern production environment that meets the highest standards in terms of quality, productivity and innovation. A very interesting opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities:

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will support customers with their maintenance activities.
• You will mainly be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs and the replacement of spare parts on industrial installations.
• You are able to work independently and are skilled in assembling and dismantling mechanical components.
• You will mainly work as part of the customer's technical maintenance team, always respecting the safety regulations applicable on site.
• You are responsible for accurately completing work orders and providing daily reports to the internal department.
• You work autonomously and maintain good communication with the customer.
• You have strong analytical skills to identify and troubleshoot technical faults and defects.
For this challenging position, you naturally need to have the right skills and experience.

• You have a strong ELECTRICAL & MECHANICAL BACKGROUND, with at least 5 years of experience as an industrial electrician.
• You are flexible regarding work locations, as you will work at different sites on a project basis.
• You are open to working in shifts (2-shift system, day shifts or night shifts – NEGOTIABLE).
• You are independent, eager to learn and not afraid of getting your hands dirty.
• You hold a valid category B driving licence and speak fluent DUTCH OR ENGLISH.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms. 

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration. 

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios. 

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place. 

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues. 

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent. 

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Analyst / Developer Mainframe (Cobol / PL1)
jobs.description:
Ready to take ownership of complex systems and contribute to meaningful digital transformation?

We're looking for an experienced Mainframe Analyst Developer who enjoys designing reliable, scalable solutions and ensuring the continuity of critical applications that serve thousands of users every day.

This is an opportunity to join a human-centered organization where your expertise is valued, your ideas make a difference, and your work-life balance truly matters.
🎯 Your role

As a key member of our development team, you will:

• Lead the technical analysis, design, development, and maintenance of core business applications

• Work on multiple layers - from business logic to system integration and user interfaces

• Translate functional needs into robust, long-term technical solutions

• Ensure the stability, performance, and quality of existing systems while contributing to modernization initiatives

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and act as a technical reference for less experienced developers

• Document and communicate your work clearly to both technical and business stakeholders

💡 What defines you

• You're results-oriented and motivated by technical excellence.

• You value quality, precision, and structured work.

• You're autonomous but thrive in a collaborative environment.

• You take initiative and enjoy improving processes and solutions.

• You communicate clearly and enjoy being a trusted technical advisor.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in software development, ideally with Mainframe systems

• Proficient in procedural programming languages such as C, Cobol, or PL/1

• Solid understanding of relational databases (SQL, DB2, etc.)

• Languages:

• 

• Strong written and spoken command of French and/or Dutch

• Good working knowledge of technical English

 

Additional assets:

• Experience with z/OS, PL/1, CICS, JCL, SOA/ESB, TWS, Web Services, or Java.

• Knowledge of accounting principles or financial applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a focus on system reliability and performance.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

As an Operator, you operate computer-controlled production machines, keeping the process efficient and high-quality. You set machine parameters, perform quality checks, and make sure the final product is packaged correctly.
A typical day? Setting up machines, following up on planning, and performing quality controls. You work together with colleagues to achieve the best results.
Do you see yourself in this role? Apply now and strengthen the team as an Operator!

• You have some experience in a production environment
• You speak Dutch or English
• Shifts are no problem for you! This can be in fixed night, 3-shift, or continuous shift systems.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.
